label: LuaJIT (process)
host: Node 22.23.1 (spawns the process and talks to it over stdio)
notes: Started as luajit -e, which prints 1 + 1 and then waits for stdin to close. Not charted: the C host is how Lua is embedded.
Memory: cgroup charge per added process, median of 3 rounds of 20; USS 188.0 KiB, PSS 226.0 KiB.
Start: median of 40 spawns until the host reads the first line.

Tool call: guest.lua formats each call and pattern-matches the reply's id. Per-call median over 50,000 calls after 5,000 warm-ups; median of 500-call batches 29.76 µs; 33.1 µs of CPU per call across host and process.

Compute: the luajit CLI running the same task an embedded state would, with lua-cjson 2.1.0.20 built from source; timed with os.clock(), which is process CPU time, because standard Lua has no finer wall clock. The embedded and process rows share this measurement.
